recipe.name: probe-experts-chebyshev-cubic
recipe.hypothesis: Reparameterize only the four independent rank1 cubic geometry master coefficients as Chebyshev T0..T3(t/4), t=4*tanh(c/4), then convert to the original Hermite coefficients before unchanged coefficient GS32/FP16 evaluation. The smooth cubic function class and zero-coefficient initial function are identical; optimizer coordinates and subsequent quantization trajectory differ. Original Hermite basis grows over t in[-4,4]; bounded Chebyshev bases may condition Adam better. This is an exploratory optimizer-coordinate hypothesis, not a variance rescaling, mean-spine coupling, new function class or proven improvement. Keep warp basis, rawscale.75, all optimizer rates/betas/decay, independent pathways, original projections, five dense MLPs, exact BF16 gather and shared backend fixed.
